Comparison

An Otter alternative: how Otter and Verbi compare

Otter added new transcription languages on November 10, 2026, Turkish, Italian and Portuguese (Brazil) among them. So the choice comes down to how you work rather than the language: in Otter you select the spoken language before you record or import, and the app’s menus stay in English; in Verbi you can pick the language or leave it on Auto-detect, and the app comes in 15 languages. Verbi is an AI voice recorder and note taker for iPhone and Android that records through the phone’s microphone, transcribes 39 languages and writes summaries that contain only what was said. It’s free to start, with 60 minutes of transcription a month.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: November 19, 2026

Which languages does Otter support?

Otter’s help center article Supported Languages was updated on November 10, 2026, and lists English (US and UK), French, Spanish, Japanese, Mandarin Chinese (Simplified), German, Italian, Cantonese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Indonesian, Malay, Dutch, Turkish, Vietnamese and Polish; Otter announced the new languages on its blog the same day. We checked it on November 19, 2026.

According to Otter’s article on transcribing in different languages, you select the language spoken in the audio before recording or importing a file; on mobile, imported files use your default language. Selecting a transcription language doesn’t change Otter’s interface: settings, menus and navigation remain in English. Look at Otter’s pages for the current state before you decide.

What does Verbi offer for meetings, lectures and interviews?

  • Transcription in 39 languages, among them English, Turkish, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese. Pick the language in Settings, or leave it on Auto-detect.
  • The app in 15 languages; summaries and chat answers come in the app’s language.
  • Recordings transcribed from start to finish, with 20 hours of transcription a month on Pro (60 minutes on the free plan; MAX doubles Pro’s hours), and Live Transcription while people speak.
  • Speaker detection with names (Pro), so you can see who said what.
  • Summaries from eleven templates, such as General Meeting, 1:1 Meeting and Action Items. They contain only what was said; owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them. The free plan includes 3 summaries a month.
  • Chat with the transcript and translation (both Pro), and Custom Vocabulary for names and acronyms.
  • Import audio files, share audio from other apps or paste a video link; copy the text, or with Pro export it as TXT or PDF.

Which one fits you?

If you want to work with recordings in a browser or on a Mac or Windows computer as well, Otter may suit your workflow. Verbi is a phone app for iPhone and Android only; it has no web or desktop version.

If you record meetings, lectures or interviews on your phone, want the app in your own language, or would rather leave the language on Auto-detect than set it before each recording, try Verbi on a real recording with the free plan. The guides to AI meeting notes and interview transcription walk through the steps.

Frequently asked questions

Does Otter support Turkish?

Yes. Turkish is in the supported-languages list in Otter’s help center, which Otter updated on November 10, 2026 (checked November 19, 2026). In Otter, you select the spoken language before recording or importing.

Is Otter’s app available in other languages?

Otter’s help center says that selecting a transcription language doesn’t change the interface: settings, menus and navigation remain in English. Verbi’s app comes in 15 languages, among them Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Italian.

Does Verbi join video calls as a bot?

No. Verbi records through your phone’s microphone, so nothing joins your call. For an online meeting, keep the phone near your speaker.

Can Verbi transcribe a recording I already have?

Yes. Tap Upload File in Verbi and pick the file, or share it to Verbi from the app it’s in. Imported files count toward the same monthly minutes.

Is Verbi free?

Verbi is free to download. The free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month, recordings kept for 15 days and 3 AI summaries a month. Verbi Pro is an optional subscription; the app shows the price before you subscribe.
